fact: ICASEES reports that the bill to replace Law No. 01.008 of 16 July 2001 on the regulation of statistical activities has passed technical validation and strategic review and is before the Commission for official draft texts; the document gives no date for these steps, so the publication date of 2026-10-10 is used.
system: Projet de loi remplaçant la loi n° 01.008 du 16 juillet 2001 relative à la réglementation des activités statistiques

fact: ICASEES reports that a multi-stakeholder workshop in Bangui on 23 April 2026 validated the draft law on the organisation and regulation of statistical activities, to replace the 2001 law, with recommendations to be incorporated before transmission to the competent bodies for adoption.
system: Projet de loi portant organisation et réglementation des activités statistiques en République Centrafricaine

fact: This document is the text of Law No. 01.008 regulating statistical activities, promulgated at Bangui on 16 July 2001 and in force from promulgation (art. 34); it creates the national statistical system, the Conseil National de la Statistique and ICASEES.
system: Loi n° 01.008 portant réglementation des activités statistiques en République Centrafricaine (2001)
